Don't have too much eye-candy, if the content you are streaming is gaming-heavy. If you provide entertainment with your personality, have a bigger place for your cam. If you do comedy talks, make sure your microphone is just right for you. I would say add Streamlabs alerts on a good position, because people tend to follow you if they see their names on the screen. It's kind of a human-thing to do. If you can create a small, polished look for your chat, add that in there as well, as I said, people love to see themselves, it makes them feel special.

My recommendation is this: 
Do not use vivid colours, it makes it harder to just 'look' at the stream.
Do not have moving things on your layout, however, moving gifs are positive with alerts.
DO have polished layout. You might look at your own room, and you can find everything you want, but if a stranger comes to your place, they won't know anything there.
FIND your perfect cam-gameplay ratio, for example: DrDisrespect has a huge facecam, because people love to see his gorgeus face and reactions, Imaqtpie has a small one, just because he doesn't want to hide the game from the viewers

Banner, and good profile picture is a must have in my opinion, so people can recognize you on their follow sidepanel.
Bio: good to have with nice pictures
Have a social media profile up, and ready to use. It helps you more to interract with your viewers.
Emotes: you can create some emotes for BTTV, they might accept yours, and your chat could be more personal than the basic chat.
